author: raxhvl
content:
This got me curious, and I implemented a teku prototype.

Its possible to keep compatibility at fork boundary, since each slot routes the gossip envelop to the fork specific (Gloas) validation. The impact on spec tests is also minimal (heze could override the block hash based check). The prototype has test cases that verify these assumptions.

https://github.com/raxhvl/teku/pull/1

Would you be open to glance through the list of assertions to see if i overlooked something?
